goal: Repair the lumped thermal model so the body starts at 333.15 K and cools toward constant ambient without heat input. Preserve C, G, T_ambient and variable T. First submit the exact public baseline to observe initialization diagnostics; this consumes one attempt. Then explain the observed diagnostic and submit a correction. No external libraries, files or network operations.
development_feedback: Initialization diagnostics are available in the assigned raw or structured format. This baseline-first protocol controls diagnostic exposure; it does not prove that source-only repair would be impossible.
